task.title: ExperimentRun -> Artifact registry writeback
acceptance: Completed ExperimentRun artifacts can be written to the artifact registry only as draft or candidate entries with deployment_stage=none
Registry entries record producer_run_id plus lineage to ExperimentRun StrategySpec and dataset refs
Non-completed runs approved-state writes and non-none deployment-stage requests are rejected
Focused ExperimentRun research orchestrator and registry tests pass
task.next: EXP-005 finalized after Claude review approval. Task commit 9d78c4b1 adds controlled ExperimentRun artifact registry writeback with draft/candidate-only and deployment_stage=none guards, producer_run_id and run/StrategySpec/dataset lineage, HTTP idempotency, and evidence/review records. Closeout verification: py_compile registry_writeback/main; git diff --check targeted EXP-005 files; pytest registry_writeback + research HTTP service + registry service -q (56 passed).
review_notes_zh: 審查通過。完成狀態守衛正確攔截（run.status != completed → raise；HTTP 409）；artifact_state 限定 draft/candidate，approved 被 _artifact_state() 拒絕；deployment_stage 從 hints/artifact 雙重來源讀取，非 none 即 raise，metadata 中亦顯式寫入 deployment_stage=none；producer_run_id 直接設為 run.run_id；lineage 完整：source_run_ids、source_strategy_spec_id（含 fallback）、source_dataset_refs 均正確組裝。HTTP 層 idempotency_key 覆蓋重複請求。56 tests pass（test_registry_writeback + HTTP service + registry suite），無迴歸。三項非阻塞觀察：底層 write_ 函式對重複 registry_id 拋出例外（非返回），可接受因 HTTP 層已攔截；metadata override 可注入 deployment_stage key 但僅影響 metadata dict，不影響 registry entry 實際欄位；缺少直接測試 artifact 層 deployment_stage 讀取路徑，但守衛邏輯正確。
